components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button { background: var(--design-colors-primary); color: var(--design-colors-on-primary); font: inherit; font-weight: var(--design-typography-label-font-weight); padding: var(--design-spacing-sm) var(--design-spacing-lg); border: 0; border-radius: var(--design-rounded-sm); cursor: pointer; transition: var(--design-motion-standard); } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--design-colors-secondary); color: var(--design-colors-on-secondary); } .ds-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: var(--design-strokes-control) solid var(--design-colors-primary); outline-offset: var(--design-spacing-xs); }

components.name: Input
components.description: A quiet text field with an explicit label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: var(--design-spacing-xs); color: var(--design-colors-on-surface); } .ds-field input { padding: var(--design-spacing-sm) var(--design-spacing-md); background: var(--design-colors-surface); color: inherit; border: var(--design-strokes-control) solid currentColor; border-radius: var(--design-rounded-sm); transition: border-color var(--design-motion-standard); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--design-colors-primary); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: var(--design-strokes-control) solid var(--design-colors-primary); outline-offset: var(--design-spacing-xs); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: A compact landmark with one active destination.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: var(--design-spacing-lg); padding: var(--design-spacing-md) var(--design-spacing-lg); background: var(--design-colors-surface); } .ds-nav a { color: var(--design-colors-on-surface); transition: color var(--design-motion-standard); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav [aria-current] { color: var(--design-colors-primary); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: var(--design-strokes-control) solid var(--design-colors-primary); outline-offset: var(--design-spacing-xs); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Short categorical metadata, never a primary action.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; padding: var(--design-spacing-xs) var(--design-spacing-sm); color: var(--design-colors-on-secondary); background: var(--design-colors-secondary); border-radius: var(--design-rounded-full); font-weight: var(--design-typography-label-font-weight); }

components.name: Card
components.description: A grouped unit with restrained depth.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: var(--design-spacing-lg); color: var(--design-colors-on-surface); background: var(--design-colors-surface); border-radius: var(--design-rounded-md); box-shadow: var(--design-shadows-ambient-low); }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: Editorial pre-heading for context, not decoration.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 var(--design-spacing-sm); color: var(--design-colors-primary); font-size: var(--design-typography-label-font-size); font-weight: var(--design-typography-label-font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--design-typography-label-letter-spacing); text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Rule
components.description: A single structural thread between editorial blocks.
components.css: .ds-rule { width: 100%; border: 0; border-top: var(--design-strokes-rule) solid var(--design-colors-primary); }

components.name: Frame
components.description: The bounded editorial canvas used by documents and decks.
components.css: .ds-frame { max-width: var(--design-layout-content-wide); margin-inline: auto; padding: var(--design-spacing-xl) var(--design-spacing-lg); color: var(--design-colors-on-surface); background: var(--design-colors-surface); }
